#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;
const long long MOD = 998244353;

long long modpow(long long a, long long b) {
    long long res = 1;
    while (b > 0) {
        if (b & 1) res = res * a % MOD;
        a = a * a % MOD;
        b >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int n;
    long long k;
    cin >> n >> k;
    vector<long long> fact(n+1), inv(n+1);
    fact[0] = 1;
    for (int i=0; i<n; i++) fact[i+1] = fact[i] * (i+1) % MOD;
    inv[n] = modpow(fact[n], MOD-2);
    for (int i=n; i>0; i--) inv[i-1] = inv[i] * i % MOD;
    auto comb = [&](int i, int j) -> long long {
        if (j<0 || j>i) return 0;
        return fact[i] * inv[j] % MOD * inv[i-j] % MOD;
    };
    if (k == 0) {
        cout << fact[n] << '\n';
    } else if (k > n) {
        cout << 0 << '\n';
    } else {
        int k2 = (int)k;
        int k3 = n - k2;
        long long ans = 0;
        for (int i=1; i<=k3; i++) {
            long long tmp = comb(k3, i) * modpow(i, n) % MOD;
            if ((k3 - i) & 1) ans = (ans - tmp + MOD) % MOD;
            else ans = (ans + tmp) % MOD;
        }
        ans = ans * 2 % MOD;
        ans = ans * comb(n, k2) % MOD;
        cout << ans << '\n';
    }
    return 0;
}
